name: committee-packet
title: Committee review packet
for_each: SELECT id,external_id FROM application_desk WHERE desk_state='committee-ready'

sections.title: Application
sections.note: Administrative completeness only. This report does not assess merit or recommend an outcome.

sections.title: Material evidence
sections.sql: SELECT name,status,evidence,recorded_by FROM materials WHERE application_id=$1 ORDER BY name

sections.title: Reader evidence
sections.sql: SELECT reader,completed_on,evidence,recorded_by FROM reviews WHERE application_id=$1 ORDER BY reader

name: decision-record
title: Recorded committee decision
for_each: SELECT id,external_id FROM applications WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM decisions WHERE application_id=applications.id)

sections.title: Application
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,name,intake,owner FROM application_desk WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Human authorisation
sections.note: Internal evidence copy. Not an offer letter, official notice or sent communication.

sections.title: Response evidence
sections.sql: SELECT r.response,r.received_on,r.evidence,r.actor FROM responses r JOIN decisions d ON d.id=r.decision_id WHERE d.application_id=$1

name: material-checklist
title: Missing material checklist
for_each: SELECT DISTINCT a.id,a.external_id FROM applications a JOIN materials m ON m.application_id=a.id WHERE m.status='missing'

sections.title: Application
sections.sql: SELECT external_id,name,intake,owner FROM application_desk WHERE id=$1

sections.title: Outstanding materials
sections.sql: SELECT name,due_on FROM materials WHERE application_id=$1 AND status='missing' ORDER BY due_on,name
sections.note: Private follow-up record. Check current evidence before contacting anyone.
